scope: Release-safe visual copy controls for Technician I Courses 3-6 production masters.

rules: Do not present study-specific cultivation values as universal targets.
Separate observation, measurement and evidence from diagnosis or root-cause conclusions.
Facility procedures, labels, manufacturer instructions and authorized roles control site-specific actions.
Do not imply that public course completion itself issues a professional credential.
All visible units, labels and decision language must match canonical lesson meaning.

prohibitedClaims: one universal VPD target; unlabeled numbers; sensor directly against lamp/duct/door as the exemplar.
assets.acceptanceCopyRule: units legible; measurement location/time context visible; no universal target claim.

prohibitedClaims: lux meter as PPFD meter; universal PPFD target; fixture wattage as equivalent to canopy PPFD.
assets.acceptanceCopyRule: sensor orientation plausible; grid is readable; PPFD units use µmol·m⁻²·s⁻¹ when a unit example is shown.

prohibitedClaims: operator opening/repairing energized equipment; arbitrary ideal sensor height; diagnosis from one outlier.
assets.acceptanceCopyRule: local-bias examples are visually obvious; workflow ends in document/escalate when unresolved.

prohibitedClaims: threshold as universal horticultural truth; auto-correction outside operator authority.
assets.acceptanceCopyRule: hypothetical/SOP-supplied threshold clearly labeled; chronology reconstructable.

prohibitedClaims: prefilled universal targets; tiny decorative fields.
assets.acceptanceCopyRule: usable in print and screen annotation; generous writing space.

prohibitedClaims: universal PPFD target.
assets.acceptanceCopyRule: PPFD unit notation accurate; grid remains readable when printed.

prohibitedClaims: EC as a nutrient-specific diagnosis; unlabeled calibration liquids; universal cannabis pH/EC target.
assets.acceptanceCopyRule: pH and EC are visibly different measurements; units/method context present; diagnostic limitation stated.

prohibitedClaims: one elapsed dryback interval as universally correct; moisture appearance alone as proof of root health.
assets.acceptanceCopyRule: repeated measurements visible; irrigation events and measurement timing distinguishable.

prohibitedClaims: “yellow leaf = nitrogen deficiency” or other one-image certainty; unsupported treatment recommendation.
assets.acceptanceCopyRule: title/caption explicitly states similar symptoms can have different causes; no single-cause verdict.

prohibitedClaims: controller status presented as proof of delivery; universal irrigation volume.
assets.acceptanceCopyRule: representative verification is visually explicit.

prohibitedClaims: automatic nutrient diagnosis from EC or symptoms.
assets.acceptanceCopyRule: unresolved status cannot visually appear closed/resolved.

prohibitedClaims: nutrient-specific conclusion field based only on EC.
assets.acceptanceCopyRule: sample identity remains linked to every recorded measurement.

prohibitedClaims: one dryback duration labeled ideal.
assets.acceptanceCopyRule: multiple sample locations supported.

prohibitedClaims: unlabeled mixed cuttings; dirty tools as normal practice; one rooting protocol as universal.
assets.acceptanceCopyRule: identity persists visually from source to propagule; sanitation is part of workflow.

prohibitedClaims: unsafe cutting posture; uncontrolled aggressive plant manipulation as universal practice.
assets.acceptanceCopyRule: work-order identity and stop boundary are prominent.

prohibitedClaims: pesticide application as default response; symptom photo as definitive diagnosis.
assets.acceptanceCopyRule: route covers representative zones; observation and diagnosis are visually separated.

prohibitedClaims: appearance-only diagnosis; fabricated pest/pathogen morphology.
assets.acceptanceCopyRule: captions use observation language and uncertainty correctly.

prohibitedClaims: pesticide as substitute for biosecurity.
assets.acceptanceCopyRule: movement direction and boundary are immediately understandable.

prohibitedClaims: undocumented corrective action.
assets.acceptanceCopyRule: chronology reconstructable without explanatory prose.

prohibitedClaims: fixed rooting hormone or environmental recipe presented universally.
assets.acceptanceCopyRule: traceability from source through resulting propagules.

prohibitedClaims: diagnosis required for every observation.
assets.acceptanceCopyRule: supports “unknown/unresolved” honestly.

prohibitedClaims: universal training schedule.
assets.acceptanceCopyRule: task scope cannot be confused with horticultural target.

prohibitedClaims: unsafe climbing/cutting posture; unlabeled material; repair of unsafe equipment; potency/readiness claims from appearance alone.
assets.acceptanceCopyRule: safety and identity checks precede action; stop-work path is prominent and non-punitive.

prohibitedClaims: unlabeled harvested material; potency/quality inferred from appearance.
assets.acceptanceCopyRule: source and receiving records visibly reconcile.

prohibitedClaims: ambiguous arrows or reused IDs.
assets.acceptanceCopyRule: learner can reconstruct ancestry from output back to source.

prohibitedClaims: silently editing a record to force agreement.
assets.acceptanceCopyRule: discrepancy remains visible until resolved by authorized process.

prohibitedClaims: one drying temperature/RH/duration as universally correct.
assets.acceptanceCopyRule: transfer ownership and identity are unambiguous.

prohibitedClaims: appearance-only harvest maturity verdict.
assets.acceptanceCopyRule: unsafe/unverified conditions support a clear stop disposition.

prohibitedClaims: fields encouraging retroactive fabrication.
assets.acceptanceCopyRule: correction and original observation remain distinguishable.

prohibitedClaims: universal drying setpoint.
assets.acceptanceCopyRule: printable, writable and sufficient to reconstruct the handoff.
